leverage.exposure: No leverage. The balance is positive after the Onyeka debit, there are no live bids outstanding and no incoming offers on any squad player, so nothing has to be unwound before the lock and the zero-points-for-a-negative-balance risk is not in play. The one exposure worth naming is procedural rather than financial: selling Amoako before fixing the shape would leave the squad with a man who is not placed in the eleven, and that is the only way a penalty can arrive this cycle. It arrives by our own hand or not at all.

binding_gap: The gap has closed for now. Midfield was the thin position and Onyeka fills it, which is why three shapes are legal where one was before. The remaining structural weakness is attack, where only two players are carried, and that is what keeps the deepest shape from being available. It is not worth fixing at current prices: no attacker on the board has enough measured output to justify the outlay, and the one position where a purchase could theoretically improve things is defence, which is already at the cap that every legal formation allows. The honest description is a squad with no hole and no depth — every man fields, nobody is spare, and the next genuine upgrade has to come from a better board rather than from a reshuffle.

verdict.headline: The Onyeka bid landed, so the squad is legal at twelve for the first time this cycle and three formations are now open instead of one.
verdict.headline_short: The Onyeka bid landed, so the squad is legal at twelve for the first t
verdict.detail: The Onyeka bid landed, so the squad is legal at twelve for the first time this cycle and three formations are now open instead of one. That unlocks two free actions and one is being missed right now: the lineup is not the optimal shape. Fix the shape first, then sell Amoako. No purchase on this board improves the fielded eleven at any affordable price, so the cash stays where it is. Order matters — the shape fix must come before the sale, or the post-sale squad has an unplaced man.

sell.reason: Amoako, and only Amoako. He is the one sale that costs nothing: the optimal shape already drops him, so the fielded eleven is identical before and after. Ligainsider's HSV probable eleven, updated after matchday one, has him neither in the starting side nor on the bench — he appears only in the wider squad list, and he is not on the injury table, so this is a selection verdict rather than a fitness one. He has no Kickbase points and no minutes at all, and his market value is falling fast enough that waiting until the lock would surrender most of what is left. Bernardo has become technically sellable now that a second legal shape exists, and that is a real change from the last run, but he is not the sale to make: only one sale is available and his would cost real fielded points where Amoako's costs none. Widmer and Lokonga both stay — Lokonga is confirmed in HSV's projected eleven, so the case against him remains a quality complaint, not an availability one.

standing.name: Amoako
standing.why: REPLACES Sj1ph47 (closed - its price was stale at 1.826.152; mv is now 1.709.447, i.e. he has shed a further 116.705 in two hours). THE CONDITION HAS FIRED: Sj1ph47 was strictly conditional on the Onyeka buy landing first, and Onyeka settled 2026-09-02T19:17:57Z at 12.900.000. The squad is 12, so a sale is legal for the first time - it takes him to 11 = 1/5/3/2, which fills 5-3-2. STILL THE ONLY POINTS-FREE SALE ON THE BOOKS, re-derived on this run's figures: the optimal shape at 12 is 5-3-2 and it already drops Amoako, so selling him leaves the fielded eleven at 1395 UNCHANGED and banks 1.709.447. Selling Widmer instead forces Amoako back in and costs 29; selling Bernardo instead costs 62 (see the companion HOLD). NEWS, DATED AND FRESH THIS RUN: Ligainsider HSV probable XI, page last updated 01.09.2026 20:31 (after MD1), for the 06.09 trip to Mainz - Amoako appears ONLY in the full squad roster, NOT among the starters and NOT on the bench. He is not on Ligainsider Verletzte-und-Gesperrte (HSV's absentees are Omari, Dickes, Roessing-Lelesiit), so this is a selection verdict, not an injury: he is fit and simply not in the picture. Kickbase gives him no p and no ap field at all - zero points, zero minutes across MD1. VALUE, SECOND REASON: mvt 2 falling, sdmvt -882.669/day, tfhmvt -116.705/2h. Over the 45,6h to the lock that is roughly another 1,7M of decay on a 1,7M asset - selling now captures nearly all of what is left. Georg bought him at +79,18% over mv, the third-highest premium in the measured log, and is -1.790.553 on him; that loss is SUNK and is not a reason to hold a player who produces nothing. WHY THE 12th BODY IS NOT WORTH KEEPING AS INSURANCE, priced honestly: the German window shut 2026-09-01T18:00Z, so no squad player can be deleted before MD2 and the -100 deletion risk is dead. The other thing a 12th body buys is the option to bench Bernardo via 4-4-2 - but that option is worth ZERO points, because 4-4-2 without Bernardo is 1333 and 5-3-2 with a non-playing Bernardo is also 1333. The option only pays if there is someone GOOD to field instead, and there is not. SEQUENCING: set the lineup to 5-3-2 BEFORE selling, or the post-sale squad of 11 has only 10 placed. Not urgent against a deadline - it has until the 2026-09-04T18:30Z lock - but every two hours costs ~117k.

buy.reason: Nothing. Sweeping the whole board against what a buy would actually have to beat, only two listings carry enough measured output to enter the eleven at all: one is a manager ask that would consume nearly the entire unwind ceiling to gain a rounding error, and the other has been unaffordable in every branch for two days and still is. Everything else has thin returns or no points history whatsoever. Three names arrived since the last run — a Dortmund midfielder, and a Frankfurt defender pair — and all three are logged as avoids: the first is out of reach, the second is priced far above the going rate for a manager ask and may be losing his place to the third, and the third would make the eleven measurably worse because he brings no measured output in place of a man who has some. A calibration correction also goes on the record this run: the Onyeka listing was uncontested, and two fresh contested clearings settled in the low teens, well under the record premium that was used to justify bidding as high as we did. The band is wide, not high. Future bids should sit in the middle of it and should check whether anyone else is even bidding before paying a contested premium.

killed_this_run.name: The 19:13-20:23Z arrivals - Nwaneri, Kosugi, Brassier - and the proof that NO buy on this board improves the eleven

A buy funded by the Amoako sale alone (squad stays 12) only enters the eleven by displacing WIDMER 29, so it needs ap > 29 at a price under 5.746.969. A buy funded by selling Amoako AND Bernardo (squad 11) needs ap > 62 at a price under 12.795.521. He also has NO ap field at all: a deadline-window arrival with zero Bundesliga minutes, so there is no points case to price. Do not let the Dortmund name or the big mv reopen this; both are transfer-window artefacts. (2) KOSUGI (12284), Keita Kosugi, FRANKFURT defender (tid 4 - confirmed via get_player on Atubolu, tn "Frankfurt"), MANAGER ASK by PhiL95 at 12.676.617 against mv 10.986.254 = +15,38%, ap 64, listed 2026-09-02T19:22:38Z. He is the ONLY asset on the whole board that clears the ap > 62 bar, and he clears it by TWO POINTS. Worked: buy Kosugi, sell Amoako and Bernardo, squad 11 = 1/5/3/2 with DEF 138+29+110+143+64 = 484, fielded ap 1397 against the 1395 baseline. That is +2 points for 12.676.617, leaving 118.904 of cash and no buffer at all - 6,3M PER MARGINAL POINT. Rejected outright. Two further strikes: as a MANAGER ASK the measured LOW cluster applies (+3,06%, +4,35%), so +15,38% is roughly four times the going rate for that kind of listing; and Frankfurt have just added Brassier at CB, which threatens the very place that produced the ap 64. (3) BRASSIER (17285), Lilian Brassier, FRANKFURT defender (tid 4), Kickbase listing 2026-09-02T20:23:34Z at EXACTLY mv 12.015.841, st=0, mvt 1, exs 43313 = expires ~2026-09-03T08:49Z. Affordable only on a full unwind (12.015.841 of 12.795.521) and it makes the team WORSE: he has NO ap field, so the post-buy eleven is 129 + (138+29+110+143+0) + 409 + 375 = 1333, sixty-two points BELOW the baseline, because Bernardo's 62 goes out and nothing measurable comes in. A brand-new signing with zero Bundesliga minutes is a bench option for his first matchday by default. He is also a SIXTH defender in shape terms - Georg already carries five and DEF caps at five in every legal Kickbase formation. THE GENERAL CONCLUSION, which is the reason this entry exists: sweeping all 25 listings against the two bars above, the only players with ap over 62 are Kosugi (64, +2 points for 12,7M) and Castello Jr. (199, 20.561.717, still unaffordable by 7,77M even on a full unwind - A2w3pzw stands). Every other listing has ap 39 or less or no history at all. So NO purchase on this board improves the fielded eleven at any affordable price, and the correct action this cycle is the free lineup fix plus the Amoako sale. REVERSAL for all three: none before MD2 locks. Re-examine Kosugi only if his ask drops to at or below mv AND Brassier has not displaced him per a dated Frankfurt XI.
